annotations.title: Save or load a query panel

description: Save, load, or list named query panels. A panel is a persisted set of queries you want to monitor over time (e.g. editorial-watchlist). Use action=save with queries[] to create, action=load to read, action=list to enumerate. Panels live under <config>/panels/<name>.json.

action.description: 'save' writes the panel, 'load' returns an existing panel, 'list' enumerates all panels.

domain.description: Default domain to track for this panel, e.g. 'automatelab.tech'.

name.description: Panel name, e.g. 'editorial-watchlist'. Used to save and recall the query set.

queries.description: Queries to save under this panel. Omit to read the existing panel.

name: panel_track

error.description: Error message when the panel was not found.

panel.description: The panel object that was saved or loaded.
